name: Corona of Dawn
body:
School evocation [good, light]; Level cleric 7, inquisitor 6, oracle 7, paladin 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a sun orchid worth 500 gp)

EFFECT

Range 20 ft.

Area 20-ft. radius centered on you
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw no; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You gain an aura of radiance, increasing the light category in a 20-foot radius around you as a daylight spell. Living creatures inside the aura heal an amount of hit points equal to half your caster level at the beginning of their turn each round. Undead creatures inside the aura take the same amount of damage instead. Undead creatures vulnerable to sunlight take damage equal to your caster level instead.

The ultraviolet light generated by the spell deals damage to fungi, mold, oozes, and slimes just as if they were undead creatures.
